title: IMLE-VLA: Fast Single-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Project page: https://kianhk6.github.io/IMLE-VLA/
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language backbones to achieve strong cross-task generalization. A leading design couples this backbone with a dedicated continuous action head trained via diffusion or flow matching. However, such heads rely on iterative multi-step sampling, for example 10 Euler steps in $π_{0.5}$. This creates an inference bottleneck that produces stop-and-go movement in the robot and slower task completion. We introduce IMLE-VLA, which replaces the iterative action head with a single-step conditional generator trained via conditional Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (cIMLE). The cIMLE objective promotes multimodal action coverage, avoiding the mode collapse of naive regression heads while eliminating multi-step sampling entirely. When IMLE-VLA is applied to $π_{0.5}$, it increases inference frequency 3.67x (55 Hz vs. 15 Hz), enabling up to 11x higher action throughput. On the 40-task LIBERO benchmark, IMLE-VLA achieves the highest average success rate (98.0%) among all baselines while leading in inference frequency. Under the test-time perturbations of LIBERO-plus, IMLE-VLA retains $π_{0.5}$'s robustness while other baselines degrade sharply, confirming that the cIMLE head preserves generalization. Real-world experiments on a Franka Emika Panda across four tasks demonstrate smoother motion (2.2x to 3.0x lower jerk) and faster task completion, with IMLE-VLA outperforming $π_{0.5}$ on every task and reducing average VLA inference time per episode by 3.9x to 6.6x. Videos and code are available at https://kianhk6.github.io/IMLE-VLA/

AI.problem: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略利用预训练的视觉-语言骨干实现跨任务泛化，但主流设计将骨干与基于扩散或流匹配的连续动作头耦合，这类动作头依赖迭代式多步采样（如π_{0.5}需10步Euler采样），造成推理瓶颈，导致机器人产生走走停停的运动、任务完成变慢。论文要解决的关键问题是：如何在保持VLA策略多模态动作覆盖与泛化能力的同时，消除迭代式多步采样带来的推理延迟瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出IMLE-VLA，将迭代式动作头替换为单步条件生成器，采用条件隐式最大似然估计（cIMLE）目标训练。cIMLE目标促进多模态动作覆盖，避免朴素回归头的模式坍缩问题，同时完全消除多步采样。IMLE-VLA可直接应用于π_{0.5}上替换其动作头。
AI.experiment: 摘要中报告了以下实验结论：（1）将IMLE-VLA应用于π_{0.5}后，推理频率提升3.67倍（从15 Hz提升至55 Hz），动作吞吐量最高提升11倍；（2）在40任务LIBERO基准上，IMLE-VLA在所有基线中取得最高平均成功率（98.0%），同时推理频率领先；（3）在LIBERO-plus的测试时扰动下，IMLE-VLA保持π_{0.5}的鲁棒性，而其他基线性能急剧下降；（4）在Franka Emika Panda上四个真实世界任务中，IMLE-VLA展现出更平滑的运动（抖动降低2.2倍至3.0倍）和更快的任务完成，在每个任务上均优于π_{0.5}，每回合平均VLA推理时间降低3.9倍至6.6倍。
